name: Airin
source: The protagonist and manager. A very bubbly, friendly, and outgoing girl with a unique way of interacting with the idol candidates and those around her in general. She prefers a more casual way of interviewing, and treats those under her management as friends and not as employees. She is given the difficult task of choosing between three idol candidates.
